notes.subject: פרס / פריסת / ופרס
notes.rationale: triple paronomasia: the word Peres (split up) both names the kingdom Persia (פרס) and describes the dividing — the pun carries the whole oracle and is lost in Bambara

notes.subject: פרס
notes.rationale: the single-word inscription term is transliterated, not translated, keeping the written-on-the-wall form

notes.subject: ⟨a⟩
notes.rationale: Bambara passive construction requires a resumptive pronoun absent in Hebrew

notes.subject: weighing verdict
notes.rationale: third of three weighed terms completing the accounting of the kingdom

translation: Peres — i ka masakɛya bɛ ⟨a⟩ εbεn, ka di ⟨a⟩ Madaw ni Peresiyaw ma.
